login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Nasq administration
login.passkeyHint: Confirm it is you with your fingerprint, face or device lock.
login.fallbackTitle: Sign in with password and authenticator code
login.fallbackHint: Enter your email and password, then the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.recoveryTitle: Sign in with a recovery code
login.recoveryHint: Enter your email, your password and one of the recovery codes you saved. Each code works once.

enroll.title: Activate your account
enroll.subtitle: Nasq administration
enroll.invalidTitle: This invitation link is not valid
enroll.invalidHint: The link may have expired or been used already. Ask an owner for a new invitation.
enroll.passkeyLead: A passkey is how you normally sign in. Your browser will ask for your fingerprint, face or device lock.
enroll.totpTitle: Set up your authenticator and password
enroll.totpLead: This is the backup way in if you lose your device. Add the account to an authenticator app, then choose a password.
enroll.qrLead: Scan the code with your authenticator app.
enroll.qrLabel: QR code to add the account to an authenticator app
enroll.setupKeyHint: Type it into your authenticator app if you cannot scan the code or open the link.
enroll.totpCodeHint: The 6-digit code shown in the app.
enroll.recoveryLead: These codes are shown only once. Each works once if you lose both your device and your authenticator app.
enroll.recoveryWarning: Copy them to a safe place now. We cannot show them again.
enroll.saved: I saved the codes in a safe place

errors.passwordShort: The password must be at least 12 characters.
errors.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.

stepUp.title: Confirm with your passkey
stepUp.lead: This action is sensitive. Confirm it is you in the browser prompt to continue.

errors.failed: Sign-in failed. Check your details and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Try again shortly.
errors.invalid: Some details are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.passkeyCancelled: The passkey request was cancelled or timed out. Try again.
errors.passkeyExists: This passkey is already registered on the account.
errors.passkeyUnsupported: This browser or device does not support passkeys.
